lesson_resources_target_check.name: lesson_resources_target_check
lesson_resources_target_check.value: ("lesson_resources"."kind" = 'link' and "lesson_resources"."url" is not null) or ("lesson_resources"."kind" <> 'link' and "lesson_resources"."asset_id" is not null)

activation_codes_activated_check.name: activation_codes_activated_check
activation_codes_activated_check.value: ("activation_codes"."status" = 'activated') = ("activation_codes"."activated_at" is not null and "activation_codes"."activated_by_user_id" is not null)

activation_codes_consumed_secrets_check.name: activation_codes_consumed_secrets_check
activation_codes_consumed_secrets_check.value: "activation_codes"."status" not in ('activated', 'revoked') or ("activation_codes"."code_ciphertext" is null and "activation_codes"."pin_ciphertext" is null)

support_tickets_requester_check.name: support_tickets_requester_check
support_tickets_requester_check.value: "support_tickets"."requester_id" is not null or "support_tickets"."requester_email" is not null
